steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each asset is placed by its score and whether its maintenance strategy fits its criticality.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Critical asset on a run-to-failure strategy
findings.fix: Move the asset to a planned strategy

findings.title: Score with no stated basis
findings.fix: State the basis for the score

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] asset-boiler-b1.md:12  Critical asset on a run-to-failure strategy.
       Fix: Move the asset to a planned strategy.
[medium] asset-motor-m4.md:19  Asset with no criticality score.
       Fix: Score the asset.
[low] asset-fan-f7.md:26  Score with no stated basis.
       Fix: State the basis for the score.
Not checked: Consequences not in the register.
pros: Checks an asset with no score, a critical asset with a run-to-failure strategy, and a score with no stated basis.
cons: Not checked: Consequences not in the register.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-asset-criticality-review skill on the records for this review.
